l1_words.meaning: a particular day of the calendar, written as day, month and year
one of the twelve parts of the year, about four weeks long
a system or chart showing the days, weeks and months of the year
the third month of the year

pattern_explanation: These words entered both languages from the same Latin sources, so the spelling and meaning stayed close in English and in the learner's first language. The accent marks in the Portuguese spelling are the main visible difference.
